news.title: BMO and Mastercard Integrate Virtual Card Payments Into Corporate Software Platforms
news.body: BMO and Mastercard have launched a new capability allowing corporate clients to manage virtual card payments directly within their existing software platforms. This strengthens BMO’s position in corporate payments and gives Mastercard deeper integration with enterprise workflows. Competing banks and card networks may need to accelerate their own embedded virtual card offerings to keep pace.

news.title: Nayax Acquires IPS Group for $350M to Expand Smart Parking Payments Platform
news.body: Nayax has acquired smart parking company IPS Group for $350 million, aiming to lead in integrated parking and payment solutions. The deal expands Nayax’s commerce enablement platform into the smart mobility sector, challenging legacy parking operators and payment processors. Further consolidation is likely as payments and IoT converge in urban infrastructure.

news.title: ECB Proposes Three Onchain Models for Central Bank Money Settlement
news.body: The European Central Bank has outlined three models for integrating central bank money onchain, including interoperable ledgers and tokenized settlement. The ECB plans to consult with banks and market infrastructures on technical standards and regulatory changes, which could reshape how wholesale payments are settled across Europe.

news.title: Lloyds Survey: 71% of UK Financial Institutions Expect Tokenisation to Transform Sector
news.body: A Lloyds survey finds that 71% of UK financial institutions believe tokenisation will reshape financial services, driving new product innovation and competition. This broad institutional consensus points to rising investment in tokenisation technologies and a likely surge in pilot projects across payments, lending, and capital markets. Regulators and incumbents will need to clarify standards as tokenised assets move toward mainstream adoption.

news.title: Mosaic Processing Calls on Platforms to Reassess Payment Acceptance Costs
news.body: Mosaic Processing is urging software platforms to review their payment acceptance integrations, highlighting opportunities for cost savings and improved customer satisfaction. This push may prompt software platforms to renegotiate terms with payment processors to secure lower fees and better integration, directly impacting processor revenues and platform competitiveness.

perspective: ECB’s onchain settlement models and Mosaic’s call for cost reviews show banks and platforms are rethinking infrastructure and economics in payments.

curiosity.text: The first virtual credit card was introduced in 2000, enabling online shoppers to generate single-use card numbers for added security in digital payments.
